About Us

Galileo is a team-based medical practice working to improve the quality and affordability of health care for all. Operating across 50 states, Galileo offers high-touch, data-driven, multi-specialty, longitudinal care to diverse and complex patients—on the phone, in the home, and everywhere in between. Regional and national health plans, employers, and Fortune 500 organizations trust Galileo as the leading solution to improve population health. Founded by Dr. Tom X. Lee, the healthcare pioneer behind One Medical and Epocrates, Galileo is a team of leading innovators from healthcare, technology, and human-centered design. Our mission is to apply that talent and scientific thinking to transform society by solving our largest, toughest healthcare problems, while at the same time bringing patient and provider closer.

Join Galileo as a Senior Data Analyst, where you'll be the cornerstone of data-driven decision-making across our entire product ecosystem. You'll build the analytical infrastructure that powers insights for Marketing, Operations, Client Services, and Customer Service teams, directly impacting how we understand and improve our users' healthcare journey. This is a role for someone who gets excited about turning messy data into pristine insights and loves being the person stakeholders rely on for game-changing analysis.

A Day in the Life

You'll spend significant time diving deep into SQL queries and dbt models, optimizing performance while ensuring data accuracy across our complex healthcare data ecosystem. Equally important is the collaborative aspect of the role: you'll partner closely with Product Engineering to understand new features, work with Marketing to track campaign effectiveness, and assist Operations in identifying workflow improvements. You'll balance heads-down technical work building data marts and pipelines with strategic conversations where you challenge stakeholders to think differently about their metrics. Your work will directly influence product roadmaps, marketing strategies, and operational decisions, always connecting data insights to real improvements in patient care delivery.

Key Responsibilities
Build and maintain dbt data marts that transform raw user data into actionable utilization profiles and behavioral segments
Create and optimize Looker dashboards that become the daily source of truth for 20+ stakeholders across 4+ departments
Partner with Product Engineering teams to implement comprehensive event tracking and behavioral analytics
Deliver subscription and retention analyses that directly inform product strategy and revenue forecasting
Reduce dashboard load times and query performance by 20%+ through systematic optimization
Conduct deep-dive user journey and funnel analyses that identify friction points and improvement opportunities
Maintain impeccable data quality standards while building self-service analytics capabilities for non-technical users
Must-Have Qualifications
7+ years of SQL experience with complex datasets, including multi-table joins and query optimization
5+ years collaborating with stakeholders across Marketing, Operations, Product, and Customer Service functions
5+ years of digital product analytics experience with subscription/SaaS business models
Proven expertise with dbt for building and maintaining data transformation pipelines
Hands-on experience with Looker, Tableau, or similar BI platforms
Track record of partnering with engineering teams and understanding technical documentation (PRDs, TDDs)
Experience with ETL tools like Fivetran and modern data stack technologies
Benefits & Why Join Us

What You'll Gain:

Direct impact on healthcare delivery for thousands of patients through data-driven improvements
Opportunity to build analytical infrastructure from the ground up in a high-growth environment
Close partnership with executives and department heads who rely on your insights for strategic decisions
Access to modern data stack and freedom to implement best-in-class tools and practices

About the American College of Surgeons

The American College of Surgeons (ACS) is a professional and educational organization of surgeons that was founded in 1913 to raise the standards of surgical practice and improve the quality of care for surgical patients. The College is dedicated to the ethical and competent practice of surgery. Its achievements have significantly influenced the course of scientific surgery in America and have established it as an important advocate for all surgical patients. The College has more than 90,000 members and is the largest organization of surgeons in the world. For more information, visit www.facs.org.

Summary: For more than a century, the American College of Surgeons (ACS) has been dedicated to improving patient outcomes. Today, we leverage modern analytics tools and data-driven insights to enhance our services, strengthen member engagement, and drive growth. We are seeking a Membership Data Analyst to join our team and help us transform complex data into actionable intelligence that supports strategic decision-making.

The ideal candidate will have experience analyzing membership data, identifying trends, and producing insights that inform retention, engagement, and recruitment strategies. This role is best suited for a professional with strong analytical, technical, and communication skills who can turn raw data into meaningful reporting for both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

This exempt position will report to the Associate Vice President in the Division of Member Services. It is based in our Chicago office and is a hybrid role: 3 days per week in the office/2 days per week remote.

The anticipated salary range for this position is $91,300 - $100,000 (commensurate with related experience).

Responsibilities:

Research & Analytics: design and execute approaches to collect, clean, and organize membership data using both primary and secondary sources; analyze data sets to identify trends, patterns, and insights into membership demographics, engagement, and retention; conduct research on key membership and practice trends in the surgery field and share updates with internal stakeholders; and oversee both quantitative and qualitative data tasks such as survey development, coding interviews, and creating dashboards or reports to communicate findings.
Data Visualization & Insights: build and maintain dashboards in Power BI (or other visualization tools) to track membership growth, engagement, retention, and other key performance indicators; present findings in a clear, accessible way to inform strategic decision-making; and collaborate with colleagues to ensure progress toward organizational membership goals is measurable and transparent.
Stakeholder Engagement & Coordination: partner with divisions and leadership teams to define KPIs and data exploration priorities; serve as a point of contact for project-related inquiries, ensuring effective collaboration across teams; translate analytical insights into clear, actionable recommendations for stakeholders; and partner with IT and other experts to maintain enterprise architectures, data models, governance, and best practices.
Management & Organization: manage project timelines and deliverables while maintaining data integrity; design and maintain scalable analytics systems and reporting processes; develop documentation such as source-to-target mappings and data model specifications; create best-practice reports that synthesize data into meaningful insights; and evaluate internal systems for efficiency, identifying areas for improvement and implementing solutions.
Collaboration with the membership marketing team to provide support and insights that facilitate a dynamic view of membership and potential members. This joint vision and action plan will facilitate achieving group, division, and enterprise KPIs surrounding membership growth.

Required Education & Experience

Bachelor’s degree or higher in mathematics, statistics, computer science, economics, social science research, business, or a related field from an accredited college or university.
3+ years experience specifically in membership, customer, or donor analytics.
Advanced proficiency in Power BI (data modeling and custom visualizations).
Familiarity with optimizing the visualization of information and awareness of user experience best practices.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Office products (Outlook, Word, Excel, and PowerPoint).
Excellent research skills and the ability to find, review, synthesize, evaluate, and translate qualitative and quantitative research findings into relevant insights.
Candidates should have experience with cohort analysis, segmentation, and predictive modeling.

Preferred Education & Experience

Relevant certifications such as Microsoft Power BI & Google Analytics.
Experience with membership lifecycle analysis, churn prediction, and retention modeling, along with healthcare or professional association experience.
Experience presenting complex data insights to Leadership and Employees; demonstrated ability to translate business questions into analytical frameworks; experience working in matrixed organizations with multiple stakeholders.
Experience with statistical analysis (including regression, correlation, and hypothesis testing); A/B testing and experimental design is a plus.
SQL query writing and database management experience.
Some exposure to Python or R for statistical analysis and data manipulation.
The ideal candidate should have experience with data warehousing concepts and ETL processes, as well as advanced Excel skills (including pivot tables, VLOOKUP, and statistical functions).
Experience with AMS/CRM platforms.

Developing and applying machine learning and deep learning models for grid forecasting, control, and predictive maintenance.

Assessing the feasibility and impact of integrating renewable energy sources into existing grids.

Analyzing test results to identify and resolve potential issues before field deployment.

About the Team

The Reliability Platforms organization is part of DoorDash's Production Lifecycle team, which owns the end-to-end experience of how engineers safely change, observe, and operate production systems.

Our mission is to enable teams to confidently make changes to production, understand reliability and service health on demand, and abstract complexity into platforms for common operations with built-in guardrails that make safe, repeatable operations the default.

Reliability Platforms builds platforms as products that touch every production change, with two primary areas of focus:

Self-Serve Infrastructure & Configuration Change Control - building the systems engineers use to provision services, request cloud resources, and safely make config changes across traffic, compute, and secrets
Reliability & Service Health - delivering unified health scores, SLOs, alerting pipelines, and automation that help engineers know what's happening, improve reliability, and act quickly when something goes wrong

Together, these focus areas form the backbone of how DoorDash engineers safely ship, observe, and remediate production systems.

About the Role

As a Software Engineer on Reliability Platforms, you'll help design and build the systems that sit at the center of every production change at DoorDash.

You'll work on the APIs, UIs, and automation that thousands of DoorDash engineers rely on every day to:

Spin up new services and request cloud resources without waiting on another team
Safely roll out configuration changes both service and infra with progressive delivery
See at a glance whether their services are healthy and how they're performing against SLOs
Diagnose and remediate incidents faster or let the system fix them automatically

And as we look forward, you'll play a key part in shaping the future of agentic, AI-assisted operations at DoorDash systems that can propose, validate, and even execute production changes autonomously, moving us toward a world where production is proactive and self-healing by default.

Your work will shape the developer experience for production at DoorDash. You'll collaborate with product engineers, other infrastructure engineers, and platform peers to create durable abstractions that make reliability the path of least resistance.

This is a high-leverage role where the platforms you build will be used by every engineer at DoorDash multiplying your impact across the entire company.

Build Self-Serve Platforms: Design and develop systems in Go that let engineers safely request infra, configure services, and manage production state.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities


Performance Monitoring and Optimization: Engineer II, Systems is responsible for monitoring system performance metrics, analyzing data to identify bottlenecks, and implementing solutions to enhance system efficiency. This includes configuring system settings, conducting regular
performance assessments, and utilizing diagnostic tools to troubleshoot issues. The role also involves collaborating with cross-functional teams to ensure optimal resource allocation and scalability of systems.


Troubleshooting and Issue Resolution: Engineer II, Systems is responsible for diagnosing and resolving technical issues related to system performance, network connectivity, and application functionality. This includes analyzing logs, performing root cause analysis, and implementing solutions to prevent future occurrences. The role requires collaboration with cross-functional
teams to ensure timely resolution of incidents and adherence to service level agreements (SLAs). Additionally, the engineer will document troubleshooting steps and resolutions in the knowledge base for future reference.

System upgrades: Engineer II, Systems is responsible for system upgrades, planning and execution of upgrade procedures, testing new systems, and documenting changes. This includes ensuring that compatibility and performance standards are met, as well as troubleshooting any issues that arise during the upgrade process.

Server Maintenance and Upgrades: Engineer II, Systems is responsible for performing regular maintenance on servers, including applying updates, patches, and upgrades to ensure optimal performance and security. This role involves monitoring server health, troubleshooting issues, and implementing solutions to enhance system reliability. Additionally, the engineer will document changes made during maintenance activities and collaborate with other IT teams to schedule downtime effectively.

System Configuration Management: Engineer II, Systems is responsible for managing and maintaining system configurations across various platforms. This includes deploying, monitoring, and updating system software and hardware configurations to ensure optimal performance and security. The role involves creating and maintaining documentation for configuration management processes, conducting regular audits of system configurations, and implementing changes as necessary to align with organizational standards.

Network Administration Support: Engineer II, Systems participates in managing and maintaining network infrastructure. This role involves troubleshooting connectivity issues, assisting in implementing security protocols, and ensuring optimal performance of network services. The engineer will also conduct regular audits, and collaborate with other IT teams to support system integration and upgrades.

Documentation of System Processes: Engineer II, Systems is responsible for creating and maintaining comprehensive documentation of system processes, configurations, and procedures. This includes developing detailed guides for system installations, updates, troubleshooting steps, and best practices to ensure operational efficiency. The engineer will also be tasked with regularly reviewing and updating documentation to reflect changes in technology or processes.

Automation of Routine Tasks: Engineer II, Systems is responsible for identifying repetitive tasks within the IT infrastructure and developing automation scripts to streamline these processes. This includes using tools such as PowerShell, Python, or others to create scripts that manage system updates, backups, and monitoring alerts. The engineer will also implement automation solutions in Cloud environments and ensure that all automated tasks are documented and maintained for future reference.

Collaboration with Cross-Functional Teams: Engineer II, Systems is responsible for collaborating with cross-functional teams, including developers, project managers, and other IT staff. This involves participating in meetings to discuss project requirements, providing technical insights, and ensuring that system architecture aligns with business needs. The engineer will also work on integrating systems and troubleshooting issues that arise during the collaboration
process.

Security Compliance and Management: Engineer II, Systems is responsible for ensuring that all systems comply with internal and external security standards. Andrew Moore, who has a track record of building impactful AI systems, designing them with human rights impact assessments as a top priority, leading the AI division of one of the world’s foremost cloud companies, and actively participating in machine learning and AI research over the past two decades.

This position will directly contribute to OAR’s A-123 internal control and audit support initiatives, ensuring compliance, risk management, and program effectiveness across EPA’s critical grant oversight activities.


Position Overview:

The Statistician/Economist/Data Scientist (SDS) is responsible for applying advanced statistical, econometric, and data science methods to support OAR’s grant oversight and risk management mission. With a strong academic background and substantial applied experience, this role provides rigorous analysis of large and complex datasets to detect trends, measure program outcomes, and flag anomalies that could indicate control weaknesses or fraud. By combining expertise in statistics, economics, and modern data science tools, the Data Scientist equips OAR leadership with evidence-based insights that strengthen decision-making and compliance.


Key Responsibilities:

Designs and implements quantitative models to assess grant performance, financial health, and compliance risks. This includes econometric analyses of funding distributions, statistical tests of program outcomes, and predictive models to identify grants most at risk of fraud or mismanagement. Produces dashboards and data visualizations that make technical findings accessible to OAR managers and auditors.




Risk Mitigation: Develops analytic tools that integrate with OAR’s internal control framework to proactively flag high-risk transactions, unusual financial activity, or performance anomalies. For example, they may build algorithms to detect outliers in disbursement patterns or identify correlations between program characteristics and compliance findings. These insights enable management to focus resources on the highest-risk areas, aligning with OMB Circular A-123’s emphasis on data-driven risk assessment.



Audit Readiness: Ensures data used in oversight and evaluation is well-documented, reproducible, and audit-ready. The Data Scientist maintains transparent coding practices, statistical documentation, and validation protocols so that results can withstand scrutiny from GAO, OIG, or other external reviewers. By adhering to federal standards for statistical quality and transparency, this role reinforces the credibility of OAR’s oversight processes.



Program Improvement: Provides OAR leadership with quantitative evidence to guide continuous improvement in grant administration. For example, regression analyses may reveal which grant characteristics are most strongly associated with delays in closeout, or time-series modeling may show trends in fraud indicators. By translating such findings into actionable recommendations, the Data Scientist helps shape policy updates, training, and process improvements that enhance the effectiveness of OAR’s programs over time.

Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Statistics, Econometrics, Computer Science, or a related field (Master’s degree preferred).
8 years of experience in data analysis, with a focus on ETL processes and data visualization.
Proficiency with data analysis and data visualization tools.
Experience with project management and collaboration tools.
Strong understanding of data quality management and the ability to identify, troubleshoot, and resolve data-related issues.
Excellent communication skills, with the ability to present data insights clearly to non-technical stakeholders.
Attention to detail and strong problem-solving skills.
Familiarity with cloud data platforms (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud) is a plus.

Our Company

The North American Electric Reliability Corporation (NERC) is a not-for-profit international regulatory authority whose mission is to assure the effective and efficient reduction of risks to the reliability and security of the grid. NERC develops and enforces Reliability Standards; annually assesses seasonal and long‐term reliability; monitors the bulk power system through system awareness; and educates, trains, and certifies industry personnel. NERC’s area of responsibility spans the continental United States, Canada, and the northern portion of Baja California, Mexico. NERC is the Electric Reliability Organization (ERO) for North America, subject to oversight by the Federal Energy Regulatory Commission (FERC) and provincial authorities in Canada. NERC’s jurisdiction includes users, owners, and operators of the bulk power system, which serves nearly 400 million people.


Our Mission

The vision for the ERO Enterprise, which is comprised of NERC and the six Regional Entities, is a highly reliable and secure North American bulk power system. Our mission is to assure the effective and efficient reduction of risks to the reliability and security of the grid.


Your Impact

Analytics is key to understanding and predicting system performance. With a mix of analytics, visualization, and modeling techniques, the Senior Data Analyst synthesizes data to help other departments, managers, and executives make business decisions and improve processes in the organization. The Senior Data Analyst may also provide data and analyses to directly support our stakeholders in improving their understanding of risks and performance and to support reliability and security of the bulk power system.


The Senior Data Analyst should be skilled in data management, analytical techniques, and metrics optimization. They combine technical skills like programming, data modeling, and statistics with soft skills like communication, analytical thinking, and problem-solving. Using these skills, the analyst will comb through diverse datasets and work with internal and external stakeholders to generate actionable business insights and solutions. The position supports NERC liaisons of application working groups, internal and external stakeholders’ requests for data or analysis, and development and coordination of enterprise performance analysis activities and participates in defining requirements for systems to support analysis and reporting. The Senior Data Analyst works with NERC’s Enterprise Technology and Engineering teams to identify data and database requirements, as well as NERC’s Project Management Office to support application development. The Senior Data Analyst reports to the Manager of Data and Analytics Integration.


Your Role
Provide industry expertise and critical thinking skills for identifying needs for developing and analyzing a range of NERC/industry databases and associated performance metrics to protect and improve North American bulk power system reliability.
Contribute to the design and implementation of centralized data collection processes and tools for collection and analysis of reliability metrics.

Conduct ad-hoc data analysis to support business decisions and strategic planning.
Communicate data insights to leadership and other stakeholders via presentations or by maintaining reports, dashboards, and visualizations.
Develop, implement, and follow policies, procedures, and processes for the collection and analysis of data.

BS or AA in information management, computer science, data analytics, economics, statistics, or business intelligence or equivalent combination of training and/or education.
Previous experience in the electric industry, electric power generation, transmission, and power system reliability as well as knowledge of the business and operational functions of an electric utility and familiarity with the risks and controls of these functions.
Seven to ten years of previous analyst experience in a data-intensive environment.
Mathematical skills including statistics.
Intermediate-level computer and programming skills in applications such as Python, Microsoft SQL Server, and Excel (i.e., Macro, VBA, PowerPivot).
Experience with business intelligence tools and systems (i.e., PowerBI, Tableau, SAS)
Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications.

Critical thinking, analytical skills, and attention to detail.

Goal-oriented with desire to learn and passion to solve complex issues and problems.

Capability to work independently or collaboratively with or leading teams and support multiple tasks concurrently.
Ability to influence and work with peers inside and outside NERC.

Understanding of bulk power system operations.

What You'll Do:

Project44 is not only making supply chain and logistics datasets available and visible to the people who need it, but enabling actionable insights from that data – and that's where we come in. Our primary focus is to provide insights to our customers. We use a variety of data sets (geospatial, time-series, etc....) to predict routes a shipment might take, estimate the time a truck/train/ship can take to arrive at its destination, and ultimately model the behavior of every "link" in the global supply "chain". Our Data Scientists collaborate with engineers, product owners, and most importantly one another to contribute insights and data science best practices to all parts of the business.

Typical day-to-day tasks for a Senior Data Scientist might include:

Perform analyses to make internal recommendations as to whether data science methods can be used to solve a given problem
Interpret and communicate analytic results to analytical and non-analytical business partners and executive decision makers
Research and evaluate new analytical methodologies, approaches, and solutions
Build, test, and deploy supervised or unsupervised learning models
Collaborate with teams to analyze the behavior of global transportation networks & supply chains
Write queries to grab the right set of data to solve problems
Build tools to enable other data scientists to scale their knowledge and increase impact
Participate in code reviews and model reviews
Collaborate with ML Ops Engineers to deploy new models to production
Mentor junior scientists on the team

What You'll Need:

7+ years professional experience working in an analytics or DS-focused role
Ability to write sophisticated data analysis & machine learning code in python
Thought leadership to take a real-world problem without a clean, pre-existing dataset and solve it
Experience developing software projects with large teams using technologies like; git, github, jira etc.
Ability to take a project from ideation to implementation with a high degree of autonomy and out-of-the box thinking
In-office Commitment: Our office is where ideas spark, connections thrive, and innovation comes alive. The expectation is to be on-site, in office four days a week as this offers the chance to immerse yourself in the energy of the office and collaborate with your co-workers. Together, we're building something extraordinary—learn, grow, and thrive in our fast-paced, transformative environment.

Master's degree or PhD in a quantitative or relevant field
Experience with the transportation and/or freight logistics industry
Experience writing production code in one or more of: Java, Scala, or Spark using Jupyter Notebooks
Experience working with IoT systems, ranging from DIY home projects to industrial IoT deployments
Have made substantive contributions to open-source projects in the areas of data science or machine learning
Published work in Data Science related journals or conferences such as ICML, NIPS, JML, KDD, ODSC, and INFORMS
